subject: MAP: Sprint-card for POC environment activation (API keys, org setup, IP/VPC tasks)
messages:
From: Carolyn Lee <carolyn@kinesishealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@kinesishealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: POC environment activation (keys/org/IP/VPC)

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to lock the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for our 2-week evaluation so we can validate performance and integration with our staging workloads. I attached a sprint-card with proposed owners but want to confirm the following critical path items so we can hit our evaluation window: 

- Redwood creates org and tenant for our POC (tenant alias: kinesis-poc)
- Redwood issues API keys and a dedicated service account with token scope limited to inference endpoints
- IP allowlist entries for our staging egress to be accepted by Redwood hosted endpoints (we will provide the IP CIDRs)
- VPC peering: we prefer cross-account peering from our AWS account (details to follow) — we need the peering template and a rough lead time

Proposed timeline: kickoff this week, infra ready by Oct 6, integration validation Oct 7–13, final acceptance by Oct 15. Can Redwood confirm owners, ETA for keys and peering template, and any blockers we should expect?

Attachments: MAP-sprintcard-v1.xlsx (proposed owners/timeline)

Best,
Carolyn Lee
Director of Integrations
Kinesis Health

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carolyn Lee <carolyn@kinesishealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC environment activation (keys/org/IP/VPC)

Carolyn —

Thanks — this is straightforward and aligned with our typical MAPs. Quick confirmation of owners and deliverables from Redwood: 

- Org & tenant creation (tenant alias kinesis-poc) — owner: Mina Haddad — ETA: by end of day Oct 2
- Service account + API keys (scoped tokens + one long-lived test key for CI) — owner: Karthik Iyer — ETA: Oct 5 (will send key rotation guidance)
- IP allowlist: we will add your CIDR(s) to the hosted allowlist as soon as you send them; request: include expected NAT egress ranges and any ephemeral ranges used by your CI runners — owner: Neha Kapoor (security) — ETA: add within 24 hours of receiving CIDRs
- VPC peering: we will share a peering template and required cross-account roles; owner: Karthik Iyer — ETA: peering template by Oct 3, peering establishment depends on your cloud team (typical 24–72h)

Key notes / caveats:
- For the API keys: production-rate limits are not applied to the POC by default; if you want sustained higher throughput we can attach a dedicated pool (requires reserved capacity contract) — we can discuss after initial validation
- Network: we need your VPC CIDR and AWS account ID for the template. If you require route-table edits/backups, include a contact for your netops person.

I attached an updated sprint-card that matches the owners above and includes a short checklist for the network team. Proposed kickoff call: Fri Oct 2 at 09:00 PT (30m). Does that work for you?

Attachments: MAP-sprintcard-v1.xlsx (updated owners/timeline)

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Carolyn Lee <carolyn@kinesishealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC environment activation (keys/org/IP/VPC)

On Thu, Oct 1, 2026 at 10:15 AM Carolyn Lee <carolyn@kinesishealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to lock the Mutual Action Plan...

Thanks team — adding a short tech checklist so Kinesis' netops/cloud team has everything to move quickly: 

API / Keys
- We will create a service account (redwood-sa-kinesis-poc) and issue 2 keys: 1 long-lived test key for CI (note: rotate after POC) and 1 ephemeral session key for manual testing. 
- Key scopes: inference:generate, inference:stream, metrics:read. If you need embeddings or reranking add-on, tell us now.
- Delivery: keys will be posted to the secure link and shared with your security contact.

Network / VPC Peering
- Required from Kinesis: AWS account ID, VPC CIDR (example 10.40.0.0/16), subnet(s) for peering if using same-region peering.
- Redwood will provide: peering template, IAM role ARNs for cross-account acceptance, and a short runbook for route table changes. See vpc-peering-template.txt attached.
- Estimated time: once we have account ID + CIDR, peer acceptance typically completes within 24–72 hours (depends on your change window).

IP Allowlist
- Preferred: provide concrete CIDR ranges for any runners and NAT gateways. We will add them to the hosted allowlist and confirm via a verification endpoint.

Security / Audit
- We will enable request-level audit logs for the POC tenant (retention 30 days). If SOC or specific evidence required, ping Neha and she will coordinate the questionnaire.

I'll prepare the keys and peering artifacts today; Mina will create the tenant. If we can get your AWS details and IP list by EOD Oct 2 we should meet the Oct 6 infra ready target.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks,
Jamal Ortiz
